# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan package and platform expansion**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a new Vulkan Silk.NET package, expands platform support, and syncs Skia m151 bug fixes. This release introduces the `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` integration package, brings font rendering to Nano Server via FreeType, and expands verified platform support to Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containers. The bundled Skia engine picks up upstream m151 bug fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream bug fixes merged** — The bundled renderer is updated with the latest upstream chrome/m151 patches, keeping SkiaSharp aligned with the current stable Skia engine. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A dedicated NuGet package for Vulkan GPU backend integration via Silk.NET is now available, making it straightforward to wire up a Vulkan surface without manual P/Invoke. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create** — A native memory leak in the raster-image failure path of `SKImage.Create` was plugged — the CoTaskMem buffer is now freed correctly when Skia rejects the pixel data. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **String allocation removed in GetEncodedText** — The null-terminated fast path in `GetEncodedText` no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing GC pressure in text-heavy rendering loops. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup pre-sized** — The uniform-name lookup map is now sized to the known uniform count upfront, eliminating repeated rehashing on first access for effects with many uniforms. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Font rendering on Nano Server via FreeType** — Nano Server's stripped GDI environment previously prevented font loading; SkiaSharp now routes font access through FreeType on that platform, fixing text rendering for Windows container workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Verified support for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server** — Containerized CI legs now confirm that SkiaSharp runs correctly on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, giving these targets the same tested-and-verified status as the mainline platforms. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
